# CCMAF Skills — Homelab (`ccmaf-skills-homelab`)

Running a home server safely: SSH hygiene, Compose stacks, updates with rollback, NAS storage health and 3-2-1 backups with restore tests, and a lawful media-server stack.

**Audience:** Hobbyists running a home server, NAS or media stack.

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-homelab@ccmaf-skills
```
